Subject: Post-demo: target $/1M benchmark & next steps

Hi Maya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and a few asks so we can model pricing and commit options for procurement:

- Volume profile (your input): you said approx 40–60M tokens/month initially, with seasonality toward the end of the year (spikes up to ~120M).
- Usage mix: primarily user-facing assistant prompts (~70%) and some batched document processing (~30%). Average request length ~400 tokens; response ~300 tokens (we used these to estimate cost).
- Latency SLO: 500ms p50, 1.2s p95 target for interactive paths.

Pricing guidance request: you mentioned a target price band in the call — can you confirm if your target is closer to $10/1M, $15/1M, or $20/1M? That helps us pick the right hosting recommendation (hosted vs dedicated vs private). For reference, we typically see the following baseline ranges across providers for comparable workloads (rough sketch, subject to your final model selection):
  - OpenAI (hosted managed): ~$20–$30 / 1M tokens
  - Anthropic (hosted managed): ~$22–$28 / 1M tokens
  - Open-model hosts / self-host (cloud infra + ops): ~$6–$14 / 1M tokens (wide variance due to infra + ops)

Attached: redwood-benchmark-compare.xlsx (sketch cost rows by token-band + commit options) and a one-pager on our Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm target $/1M band and expected contract term (monthly vs 6/12 mo commit).
2) If you want a low-cost committed option, we’ll put together a Dedicated sizing + bill-of-materials and a 2-week pilot plan.
3) If procurement needs SOC2 + data flow diagrams, we’ll share the evidence bundle (happy to loop in Security).

If you’re available this week, I can drop a 30-min follow-up to walk the sheet and lock on a target.

Thanks,
--

Thanks Priyom — good summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side: we expect to land in the 50–70M tokens/month range after P0 (so your 40–60M estimate was accurate). Peak cadence plug: some days could spike to ~200 concurrent users for the assistant use-case.

Budget / pricing signals from procurement: the execs are looking for a blended target around $12–$16 / 1M tokens initially — $15/1M would be ideal if we can get predictable latency and a simple procurement path. They have a hard monthly target for P0 of $800–$1,500 (we’re prototyping cost internally and stacking seat/license costs on top). If Dedicated gives us predictability at scale, procurement is open to a commit but needs a clear TCO comparison vs hosted.

Requests:
- Can you provide a short table that compares total monthly cost for 50M and 150M token volumes across: Redwood Hosted (proposed), Redwood Dedicated (6-mo commit), OpenAI, Anthropic, and a rough self-host scenario? Include the assumptions you used (avg tokens/req, caching, batching).
- Also need SOC2 type II evidence + data retention policy for procurement review (we’ll share a redlined NDA after the commercial discussion).

If possible, aim to get that comparative table by EOD Wednesday; procurement wants it for the next-week budget sync.

Appreciate it —
Maya

Maya — attached is the quick sketch you asked for (sheet tab: "Client-50-150M-summary"). Quick executive summary below (assumptions: avg request+response = 700 tokens, KV cache reduces repeat token cost by ~12% for conversational flows, no embedding heavy workload):

Estimated gross cost (per provider) — 50M tokens / month:
- Redwood Hosted (proposed): $15 / 1M => $750 / month (includes managed runtime, prefix caching, no infra commitment)
- Redwood Dedicated (6mo commit): $9 / 1M => $450 / month (assumes 6-mo reserved pool, strict usage profile, ops uplift included in commit)
- OpenAI (public pricing proxy): ~$22 / 1M => $1,100 / month (note: higher for higher context models; limited batching customization)
- Anthropic (public pricing proxy): ~$24 / 1M => $1,200 / month
- Self-hosted on cloud (infra + ops estimate): ~$6–$12 / 1M => $300–$600 / month (wide range; excludes internal SRE costs and MLOps overhead)

At 150M tokens / month (scale math): multiply the per-1M linearly, but note Dedicated exhibits step improvements due to reserved capacity and batching:
- Redwood Hosted: $2,250 / month
- Redwood Dedicated: $1,350 / month
- OpenAI: ~$3,300 / month
- Anthropic: ~$3,600 / month
- Self-hosted: $900–$1,800 / month (again, ops hidden costs are material)

Key tradeoffs (short):
- Cost vs Ops: Self-host wins raw unit cost but requires significant SRE/infra investment (monitoring, model updates, security patching).
- Predictability: Dedicated gives strong unit savings with commit, plus predictable SLA and support escalation path (we include canary capacity and rollback policies).
- Features: Hosted gives fastest time-to-value with streaming + tool calling; Dedicated can be tuned for lower latencies and larger batching windows.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll schedule a 30-min "pricing deep-dive" with our SRE and Solutions Engineer (Neha) to walk the sheet and call out realistic committed sizing — propose Wed 9th 15:00 PT.
2) We’ll attach SOC2 evidence bundle and a procurement template (NDA + SOW stub) in the shared Drive link.
3) If Ingestor wants to pursue Dedicated, we’ll run a 2-week pilot with usage telemetry and a mid-pilot review to tune caching and kernel selection.

If $15/1M is your target, we can frame a Hosted + 90-day runway with an optional commit to hit ~$9/1M after the 6-mo reserved discount. I’ll include that scenario in the sheet.

Cheers —
--
Priyom Das
